common.error_try_again: A temporary technical issue occurred. Please try again shortly.
common.no_active_city: No city is active yet. Launch will be announced soon.
common.unknown_command: 🤔 I didn't understand that. Send /help to see what I can do.
driver.ask_location: 📍 Send your current location so the nearest orders reach you — use the location button below.
driver.ask_name: Send your full name as written on your ID:
driver.ask_phone: 📱 Tap the share-number button below — one tap is all it takes.
driver.available_needs_location:
⚠️ Your availability is recorded — but no order will reach you until you send your location.
Dispatch searches for the nearest driver, and a driver without a location does not appear in that search.
driver.help:
Commands:
/available start receiving orders
/unavailable stop receiving
/subscription your subscription status
/help this list
driver.location_invalid: Invalid location. Please resend using the location button.
driver.location_saved: Your location was saved. Nearby requests will reach you.
driver.location_saved_now_live:
✅ Your location is saved and you are now genuinely visible to dispatch.
Nearby orders will start reaching you.
driver.name_is_command: That is a command, not a name. Send your full name.
driver.name_looks_invalid: 🤔 That doesn't look like a real name. Send the name people call you by — no symbols or repeated letters.
driver.name_too_short: That name is too short. Send your full name.
driver.no_live_subscription: No live subscription, so no orders will reach you. Send /subscription.
driver.not_verified: Your account awaits admin verification; no orders arrive before that.
driver.now_available: You are now available for orders.
driver.offer_accepted: The order is yours. Head to the pickup point.
driver.offer_received: New request {distance} km away. You have {seconds} seconds to reply.
driver.offer_taken: Another driver took this order first.
driver.phone_must_use_button: 📱 Please tap the share-number button below instead of typing it — one tap, and it guarantees customers reach you on the right number.
driver.phone_not_yours: 🤝 That contact card belongs to someone else. Tap the button below to share your own number — customers will use it to reach you.
driver.registered: You are registered, {name}, in {city}. Your account awaits admin verification.
driver.subscription_none: No live subscription. Monthly price for {plan}: {price} {currency}.
driver.welcome: Welcome to Waslah for drivers. Let's finish your registration.
group.escalation_reason_no_driver_at_all: No available driver in the city at all
group.escalation_reason_unsubscribed_cyc: Unsubscribed-group cycles exhausted with no agreement
language.choose: 🌐 Pick your language — every bot message will come in it, and the other party's messages will be translated into it.
language.not_registered: ⚠️ Send /start first so we know you, then pick your language.
language.unchanged: ✅ Your language is already {language}, nothing changed.
language.unsupported: ⚠️ That language isn't supported yet. Available: Arabic, English, Urdu.
negotiation.agreed_driver: ✅ Agreed — the request is yours. Pickup details are on the way.
negotiation.agreed_rider: ✅ Your agreement with the driver is confirmed. Have a good trip.
negotiation.claim_registered_active: ✅ It's your turn. Talk to the rider right here — send your message and it will reach them. You have {seconds} seconds to agree.
negotiation.claim_registered_waiting: ⏳ You're registered at position {position}. We'll notify you the moment it's your turn.
negotiation.claim_rejected_already: ⚠️ You're already registered for this request.
negotiation.claim_rejected_closed: ⚠️ This request has timed out or was assigned to someone else.
negotiation.claim_rejected_excluded: ⚠️ You took part in the previous cycle for this request; your chance is the cycle after.
negotiation.claim_rejected_full: ⚠️ This request is full. Wait for the next cycle.
negotiation.driver_turn_closed_declined: 🔁 No agreement this time. Thank you — more chances are coming.
negotiation.driver_turn_closed_expired: ⏳ Your turn timed out without agreement; the request moved to the next driver.
negotiation.driver_turn_opened: ✅ Your turn (position {position}). Send your message to the rider here. You have {seconds} seconds.
negotiation.exhausted_rider: ⚠️ We couldn't reach an agreement this round. Your request went to the operations team for manual follow-up.
negotiation.relay_redacted: ⚠️ A number in your message was hidden. Contact stays inside the app to protect both sides.
negotiation.relay_unreachable: ⚠️ Your message couldn't reach the other party right now. We'll retry or move on.
negotiation.rider_turn_closed: ⏳ The chat with this driver is closed. Moving to the next one right away.
negotiation.rider_turn_opened: 💬 A driver ({position}) is ready to agree with you. Type here and your message reaches them directly. You have {seconds} seconds, then we move to the next driver.
rating.already_rated: ⚠️ You already rated this ride, and ratings cannot be changed.
rating.invalid_stars: ⚠️ Ratings run from one to five stars.
rating.not_a_party: ⚠️ You cannot rate a ride you were not part of.
rating.ride_not_completable: ⚠️ You have no ride in progress to complete.
rating.ride_not_completed: ⚠️ A ride that has not ended cannot be rated.
rating.ride_not_startable: ⚠️ You have no assigned ride ready to start right now.
rating.ride_started: 🚗 Ride started. Have a safe trip — send /complete on arrival.
rating.started_rider:
🚗 Your driver {driver} is on the way — ride {order} has started.
You will be asked to rate on arrival.
rating.summary_none: No ratings yet — complete your first ride.
rating.window_closed: ⏳ The rating window for this ride has closed.
rider.ask_dropoff: Share your destination, or send /skip to explain it to the driver.
rider.ask_parcel: Describe the parcel briefly: what is it, and roughly how big?
rider.ask_parcel_dropoff: Share the parcel drop-off location using the location button.
rider.ask_parcel_pickup: Share the parcel pickup location using the location button.
rider.ask_pickup: Share your pickup location using the location button.
rider.ask_service: Which service do you need now?
rider.delivery_dropoff_required: Delivery needs a specific drop-off location. Send it using the location button.
rider.drivers_notified: {count} driver(s) were notified about your request.
rider.help:
Commands:
/ride request a ride
/delivery request a delivery
/cancel cancel your current order
/help this list
rider.location_required:
📍 I need your location via Telegram's location button — a typed address isn't enough for the driver.
Button not working? Send /cancel to start over.
rider.no_driver_found:
🚫 We have not found an available driver for your request yet.

We have referred it to the dispatch team, who will follow it up manually. We will tell you as soon as a driver is available.

Send /cancel if you no longer need it.
rider.no_driver_found_delivery:
🚫 We have not found an available courier for your request yet.

We have referred it to the dispatch team, who will follow it up manually. We will tell you as soon as a courier is available.

Send /cancel if you no longer need it.
rider.outside_city: The location you sent is outside the {city} service area.
rider.parcel_invalid: The description is too short. Write a clear description of the parcel.
rider.parcel_too_long: The description is too long. Please shorten it.
rider.welcome: Welcome to Waslah. Request a ride in two steps.
subscription.expiring_soon:
⏳ Heads up: your subscription ends in {days} day(s) — on {date}.
Renew before then so orders keep reaching you. Send /subscription for details.
subscription.expiring_tomorrow: ⚠️ Your subscription ends tomorrow, {date}. Renew today so orders keep reaching you.
support.action_done_activate: ✅ Subscription activated and the owner was notified — ticket {ticket_short} closed.
support.action_done_reject: ⛔ Request rejected and the owner was notified — ticket {ticket_short} closed.
support.action_done_terminate: 🛑 Subscription terminated and the owner was notified — ticket {ticket_short} closed.
support.advice_feedback_thanks: Thanks — your rating of the suggestion was recorded. Nothing changed on the ticket.
support.ask_message: 📝 Describe your problem in one message. If you have a transfer receipt, send the photo directly — a photo with a short caption is enough.
support.blocked: ⚠️ Your account is currently suspended and can't open a support ticket.
support.choose_type: ⚠️ What kind of issue is this? Pick a button so the right support team gets it.
support.city_group_missing: ⚠️ Support isn't set up in your city yet. Contact the platform administration directly until it is.
support.cooldown_active: ⏳ You already have a ticket that just reached the team. Wait {minutes} minutes before sending another — repeating won't speed it up.
support.help: 🆘 /support — open a ticket with the support team, receipt photo optional.
support.message_is_command: ⚠️ That's a command, not a description. Describe the problem in your own words, or send /cancel to exit.
support.message_too_long: ⚠️ That message is too long. Keep it under three thousand characters and share extra details after support replies.
support.message_too_short: ⚠️ That description is too short. Write what happened in detail (at least ten characters) so support understands it the first time.
support.no_driver_on_ticket: ⚠️ This ticket has no driver, so there is no subscription to change.
support.not_authorized: ⛔ This action is for support and admin staff only.
support.not_registered: ⚠️ Register first with /start so we know who you are before opening a ticket.
support.photo_only_message: Sent a receipt photo with no caption — please review it.
support.resolved_activated: ✅ Your subscription is now active. Send /available to start receiving orders right away.
support.resolved_rejected: ⚠️ Support reviewed your request and couldn't approve it. Send /support again with clearer details or a receipt photo.
support.resolved_terminated: ⚠️ Your subscription was terminated by the support team. Use /support if you want to appeal.
support.subscription_driver_only: ⚠️ Subscription issues are for drivers. If your problem is about a ride, pick “Ride dispute”.
